stage1.impression: A long night bar whose spectrum of glowing panels is a strong, graphic idea, and the receding row of stools gives real depth. It still reads as a CG interior: the panels are flat, evenly lit coloured rectangles; the foreground stools are heavy, near-black silhouettes that block the hero; the floor is a muddy brown-black that barely picks up the panels' colour; a white hotspot on the floor at right pulls the eye; and the back-bar is a wall of near-identical bottles under a blank grey ceiling.

blocking_9: The spectrum must read as light coming through cast acrylic, with internal depth, a soft bloom and a visible grade, not as flat painted rectangles (per-panel lum_range inside the panel above the stools under 20 now)
The floor must carry each panel's colour as a coloured reflection and spill pool in front of it; now the floor under the green and yellow panels measures b_median 2 and lum_median 29
The foreground stools must stop blotting out the red and orange panels: the first stool covers about 40% of the red panel
No specular hotspot brighter than the panels anywhere in the frame (the floor glare at 1650-1950 x 1050-1400 has p95 242, against panel tops of about 135)
Shadows must hold detail: the bottom of the frame is 10% crushed with blue at 1, a dead orange-black
The back-bar must stop reading as one bottle model repeated by the hundred
The ceiling and right wall need a reason to exist (the membrane at 0.004 reads as a blank grey slab)

defects.what: Bar panels read as flat emissive rectangles: even colour, hard 1 px seams between panels, no depth or bloom from the acrylic
The nearest stool is a near-black silhouette that covers most of the red panel and the lower left corner
Second stool silhouette across the orange panel
White specular streak on the floor from a pendant or spot, the brightest thing in the lower frame (p95 242)
Floor crushed and colourless: lum_median 21, crush 10%, b_median 1
Floor in front of the yellow and green panels shows almost none of their colour (b 2, lum 29)
Back-bar packed with repeated copies of the same bottle and label; busy, competes with the panels
Ceiling and upper right wall a flat warm grey with no detail or gradient (lum_range 43)
Violet and smoke panels clip in blue (0.7% and 0.3%); the violet reads as screen blue-purple
Clear acrylic speaker in the back-bar niche is murky and nearly invisible; reads as a fogged box
Lounge chairs at right overlap each other in depth, cluttering the background

changes.problem: The two nearest stools are black silhouettes that cover the red and orange panels, the start of the spectrum the frame exists to show.

evidence.measured: stool tops and legs sit at lum about 10-25 over panels at 110-135; the first stool covers about 40% of the red panel

change.from: evenly spaced stools from the frame edge
change.to: remove the first two stools nearest the camera, or slide every stool 0.9 m further along the bar, so the red and orange panels are clear from top to floor

changes.expected: The red and orange panels read whole; the stools start at the yellow panel and recede as a rhythm instead of a wall

changes.problem: The floor neither reflects nor catches the panels' colour, so the bar floats and the spectrum stops at the kick rail.

evidence.measured: lum_median 29, b_median 2, under a panel at lum 140

change.to: mid-grey polished, sealed concrete: base albedo about 0.25, roughness 0.18-0.25 with a fine noise variation and faint aggregate, so it carries a soft coloured reflection of each panel 0.5-1 m out

changes.expected: A soft coloured stripe of each panel's hue on the floor in front of it, fading toward the camera

changes.problem: The panels read as flat, painted emissive cards rather than light through tinted acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_range 17.6 inside the red panel; panel seams step 83 levels in 1 px

change.from: 1.4, gradient 0.2 at the foot to 1.0 at the top, uniform across the width
change.to: 1.1, with a non-uniform LED falloff: brighter at the top edge and about 0.35 at the foot, plus a slight brightening at each panel's vertical edges; add a thin 2-3 mm dark reveal between panels with a faint bright edge where the acrylic edge glows

changes.expected: Each panel shows visible graded depth (top to foot ratio about 2.5:1) and reads as cast acrylic with edges, not a flat card

changes.problem: A white specular streak on the floor at right is brighter than the panels and draws the eye away from the bar.

evidence.measured: p95 242 against panel tops of about 135

change.setting: bar-top pinholes 5 x spot 140 W / Bell pendants 25 W
change.from: pinhole spots at 140 W, cone 30, hitting the open floor
change.to: pinholes at 70 W, aimed onto the bar top only (cone 22); Bell pendants at 18 W

changes.expected: No hotspot on the floor; the brightest floor value comes from the panels' reflection

changes.problem: The shadows are crushed to a colourless orange-black, and the 3300 K balance turns every neutral muddy brown.

change.to: 3700 K, tint -4, exposure +0.15, with a gentle toe lift so the floor's blacks sit near 12-15 rather than 2

changes.expected: The floor and stool legs hold texture; neutrals read as warm grey, not brown

changes.problem: The back-bar is a dense wall of identical bottles that reads as instanced CG and competes with the spectrum below.

evidence.measured: seen: the same bottle and label model repeated across every shelf; lum_p95 97.5 spread evenly over the whole wall

change.from: every shelf full of one bottle model
change.to: cut the bottles by about 60%, mix 5-6 distinct shapes and heights, and leave gaps with a few records or glassware; shelves 0.05 so the back-bar sits a stop under the panels

changes.expected: The back-bar reads as a curated, quieter layer behind the hero

changes.problem: The ceiling and right wall are a blank, even grey slab with nothing to read.

change.to: membrane 0.0025; add a soft grazing wash down the right wall from the record-wall spots (30 W, cone 35); haze 0.018 so the pendants' cones read faintly

changes.expected: The upper right falls off into soft darkness with one gentle wash, and depth reads through faint haze

changes.problem: The violet and smoke panels clip in blue and read as screen colour rather than tinted acrylic.

change.to: a highlight shoulder on blue and violet hues only, keeping peak blue under 235 without shifting their hue

changes.expected: The violet panel holds tone across its face; no clipped blue

out_of_scope.request: Make the clear acrylic speaker in the back-bar niche read more clearly (it is murky and nearly invisible)
out_of_scope.why: Its material and colour are a fixed product; only the light on it may change (a dedicated back light from the Fog niche at 0.05 could help)

out_of_scope.request: Different panel colours or order to calm the spectrum
out_of_scope.why: The eight panels in spectrum order are a fixed part of the room's design
